opportunities.title: Human–AI collaboration contracts
opportunities.summary: Help make tasks, approvals, handoffs, and decisions understandable to both human contributors and coding agents.
opportunities.scope: Propose a schema, small validator, or corresponding tests; agree on a scoped issue first.

opportunities.title: Agent-workflow regression tests
opportunities.summary: Develop representative test cases that can show whether team planning and delegation have improved.
opportunities.scope: One deterministic fixture and one documented acceptance test.

opportunities.title: Development-landscape usability
opportunities.summary: Help contributors navigate repository relationships, visualize architecture, and distinguish observed facts from hypotheses.
opportunities.scope: A narrow visual or accessibility improvement with reproducible verification.

opportunities.title: Offline mobile game accessibility
opportunities.summary: Evaluate keyboard, touch, screen-reader, small-screen, and offline usability of the browser game.
opportunities.scope: A reproducible report or targeted regression fix with device/browser notes.

opportunities.title: Reproducible ecological analysis
opportunities.summary: Improve verification, provenance, and examples for terrain and landscape-analysis skills.
opportunities.scope: Improve a public example or verify an existing analysis workflow.

opportunities.title: Local-first development reliability
opportunities.summary: Help test reproducible local setup, CI hardening, diagnostics, and developer onboarding.
opportunities.scope: A small, reviewable documentation, CI, or reproducibility improvement.
